newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 257 OF OCTOBER 10, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 257 OF OCTOBER 10, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Corrigendum to Commission Decision 96/360/EC of 5 June 1996 authorizing Ireland to adjust the method for calculating the somatic cell count in cows' milk (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 138 of 11 June 1996)

COMMISSION DECISION of 30 September 1996 on the publication of the list of recognized organizations which have been notified by Member States in accordance with Council Directive 94/57/EC (Text with EEA relevance) (96/587/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 9 April 1996 concerning the withdrawal of authorizations for plant protection products containing propham as an active substance (Text with EEA relevance) (96/586/EC)
COUNCIL DIRECTIVE 96/61/EC of 24 September 1996 concerning integrated pollution prevention and control
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1951/96 of 9 October 1996 fixing the import duties in the rice sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1950/96 of 9 October 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1949/96 of 9 October 1996 opening a standing invitation to tender for the export of barley held by the Finnish intervention agency
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1948/96 of 9 October 1996 opening a standing invitation to tender for the export of barley held by the Swedish intervention agency
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1947/96 of 9 October 1996 opening a standing invitation to tender for the export of barley held by the Danish intervention agency
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1946/96 of 9 October 1996 fixing the representative prices and the additional import duties for molasses in the sugar sector

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1945/96 of 9 October 1996 fixing the maximum export refund for white sugar for the 10th partial invitation to tender issued within the framework of the standing invitation to tender provided for in Regulation (EC) No 1464/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1944/96 of 9 October 1996 fixing the export refunds on white sugar and raw sugar exported in its unaltered state END OF DOCUMENT.
